thread:
Avery (CEO): Quick capture from today's all-hands Q&A: wanted a short list of why we win vs lose and the most common asks from customers. I'll start with the highlights then assign follow-ups.

Maya (Sales): Field note: wins when we show predictable latency + straightforward cost examples. Losses mostly revolve around SSO/BYOK questions or uncertainty about private deployment. A recurring ask: dedicated capacity SLAs.

Priya (CS): Post-sale pattern: customers that follow our Optimize recommendations and use the SE onboarding kit stay. We lose customers when runbooks/dashboards are missing.

Leo (SE): Tech asks: model pinning, deterministic evals, and small rollout examples. A 3-line config snippet often removes friction.

Jon (Eng): Eng update: main technical loss vector is long-tail latency under bursty batching. We're shipping per-request trace ids and KV-cache metrics to help debug.

Sam (Product): Product take: top asks to prioritize are BYOK/KMS, enterprise audit logs, and a SOC2 artifact pack for sales. I'll draft a short roadmap note.

Avery (CEO): Action items: @Sam one-page BYOK/KMS brief for sales by EOD tomorrow; @Leo add a 1-page POC checklist to the SE kit; leadership will request a small docs sprint from finance.

All-Hands Bot: Notes + action items -> https://notion.redwood/workspace/all-hands-1774998888

Maya (Sales): :thumbsup: This should reduce deal time.

Priya (CS): Can someone pull a quarter-to-date list of lost deals by reason? That helped prioritize last cycle.

Sam (Product): I'll pull that with @Maya and share by Friday.

Avery (CEO): Thanks all. If you have customer quotes, add them to the Notion page. Closing thread.
